subject.title: Memory MVP: add ingestion helpers and CLI/skill surface

question: Should OpenClaw standardize a first-class memory operator facade in the default memory plugin now, route this to plugin/ClawHub packages, or wait until the schema/provenance/write/review companion issues are resolved?
rationale: The source gap is real, but the requested commands define new user-facing memory lifecycle, provenance, and plugin-boundary semantics that automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Keep As MVP Design Tracker
options.body: Leave this open until the schema, provenance, write-pipeline, and review/edit/forget tracks converge, then implement a small default-plugin operator facade.

options.title: Route To Plugin Or ClawHub
options.body: Close core work if maintainers decide Engram, Memory Wiki, LanceDB, or another plugin package is the right boundary and no SDK gap remains.

options.title: Implement Immediately In Memory Core
options.body: Add the commands now, accepting the risk of duplicating existing plugin surfaces or locking lifecycle semantics early.

recommendation.title: Keep As MVP Design Tracker
recommendation.body: Leave this open until the schema, provenance, write-pipeline, and review/edit/forget tracks converge, then implement a small default-plugin operator facade.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent current-main history across memory-core CLI/tools/docs and plugin-boundary refactors.
